# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native, mobile portrait arcade duel game titled **World Duel Circuit: Rival Rush**. Preserve the source mechanics: full-screen canvas arena, start/shop/mode/restart UI, virtual joystick movement, hold-fire auto-target projectiles, ammo/focus reload, escalating enemy waves, HP, currency rewards, optional AI tag partners, and optional center-objective defense with repair radius. Reinterpret the experience as a Street Fighter-inspired global tournament: the player is an angular code-drawn fighter using readable Super Art projectiles against rushing rival silhouettes. Waves are Rounds, ammo is Focus, money is Prize Purse, weapons are Training Hall archetypes, and the defend core is a glowing Center Ring crest. Use Russo One/Rajdhani fonts, heroic catalog audio, compact combat GIF feedback, neon-crowd procedural background rings, and portrait-first touch controls in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — World Duel Circuit: Rival Rush

## Source game identity as implemented
The preserved source was a mobile-first canvas arena survival/defense shooter named around neon collection/debt. It used a full-screen canvas, start menu, shop, optional squad lobby, virtual joystick, hold-to-fire button, ammo/reload, auto-target bullets/rockets, enemy swarms, HP, currency rewards, waves, and game-over/restart. Defend mode added a central breach/core with repair radius and separate HP.

## Protected mechanic truth
- Start/menu/shop/mode/restart states.
- Three modes: solo, squad partners, and defend objective.
- Virtual joystick movement and separate hold-fire control.
- Auto-target special/projectile firing with preserved weapon stats, ammo, cooldown, reload, projectile lifetime, and rocket splash.
- Enemy/rival spawning around player or objective, chasing targets, contact damage, separation, wave escalation, kill reward, and saved currency/ownership.
- Defend objective HP, repair radius, repair rate, and fail state.

## Safe theming surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, menu copy, shop names, mode descriptions, entity drawing, background drawing, color palette, procedural particles, audio/GIF accents, and mobile chrome are safe to transform because they do not alter collision, timing, scoring, or progression semantics.

## Remixed target
A portrait arcade global duel tournament where the player is a special-move fighter surviving rival rush rounds. The old swarm combat becomes iconic rival pressure; projectiles become readable Super Arts; ammo becomes Focus; shop weapons become fighter archetypes; defend mode becomes guarding the tournament ring crest.
